{{Otheruses|Ocean}}
'''Osik Ocean''' was what the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] called the waste processing plant, though every species had a similar name for it. It was where all the sewage from the [[Gimmut sewage tunnel]] went.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
